name: OKC_XPRT_QUESTION_CONDITIONS
description: This table stores all the conditions of the QUESTIONs. This is a child entity of QUESTION header entity.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates if condition type is a variable or question. FK to FND lookup OKC_XPRT_COND_OBJECT_TYPE

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: This is used where the condition types are variables or questoins.. The code identifies the actual variable or the question used in the condition.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE_DATATYPE
columns.description: Indicates the datatype for the object_code. For Clause this is NULL.  Used values are 'N': Numeric variable or Numeric Question, 'V': Character variable, 'L': Character Question, 'B': Boolean (Yes/No) quesion.

columns.name: OPERATOR
columns.description: Condition operator for Numeric variables and Questions: <=, >=, <>, = , >, <. For Character type variables and questions: IS, IS NOT, IN, NOT IN.

columns.name: OBJECT_VALUE_SET_NAME
columns.description: FND value set name of Variables / Questions for the RHS of condition.

columns.name: OBJECT_VALUE_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates if the RHS of condition is CLAUSE, VARIABLE, QUESTION, CONSTANT, VALUE. FK to FND lookup OKC_XPRT_COND_VALUE_TYPE.

columns.name: OBJECT_VALUE_CODE
columns.description: Variable's value Id or Variable code or Clause Id or Constant Id or Question Id. This will be populated only if the condition has one value.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
